countMeaning: Harness canary cases, completed baseline measurements, actual hydrated journeys and owned-identity guard. Paint canaries run once per isolated engine worker across widths/text sizes; every product fixture and hydrated journey retains the full palette matrix. Negative controls must be detected; product baseline failures are reported separately and never counted as fix acceptance.

execution.canaryScope: Independent important white/black paint, once per worker across all engine/width/text combinations; product palettes remain exhaustive.

limitations: Desktop emulation only; physical devices, mobile keyboards and assistive technology remain unqualified.
Native pixel checks use same-engine en-US input paint and a97-percent ink-retention tolerance; unsupported or missing text-paint evidence is unavailable, never a pass.
Foundation mode observes existing product defects. Dependent task mode rejects errors and unavailable required evidence.
